items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: So they sent for me, some guy fainted or something, I don’t know, but I went and joined, for Bud Billings.

ctx.x: No that’s not a name I know.

He had a Mickey Mouse band, a real good one though, but I couldn’t read good enough so I couldn’t get in that. So they sent for me, some guy fainted or something, I don’t know, but I went and joined, for Bud Billings. So I joined them in Philadelphia, and it was great playing with Stan Kenton. I loved it. A huge sounding band.
